meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按你给的时间范围查会议，取回每场会议的纪要文档和逐字稿链接，整理成单日概览或周报形式的结构化报告，需要时还能生成云文档。
howto.when: 当你要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾某段时间的会议内容时触发；未指定时间范围时默认取过去 7 天。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
回顾上周的会议，生成一份周报

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude queries meetings in a given time range, retrieves each meeting's notes and transcript links, and compiles a structured report as a daily overview or weekly digest; it can create a Lark doc on request.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to organize meeting notes, generate a weekly meeting report, or review meetings over a period; the default range is the past 7 days.

say_en.text: Help me organize this week's meeting notes
Which meetings did I have today?
Review last week's meetings and write a weekly report
